meta.name: churn-prevention
meta.description: When the user wants to reduce churn, build cancellation flows, set up save offers, recover failed payments, or implement retention strategies. Also use when the user mentions 'churn,' 'cancel flow,' 'offboarding,' 'save offer,' 'dunning,' 'failed payment recovery,' 'win-back,' 'retention,' 'exit survey,' 'pause subscription,' 'involuntary churn,' 'people keep canceling,' 'churn rate is too high,' 'how do I keep users,' or 'customers are leaving.' Use this whenever someone is losing subscribers or wants to build systems to prevent it. For post-cancel win-back email sequences, see emails. For in-app upgrade paywalls, see paywalls.

copy.tagline: 减少用户流失，构建挽留策略与取消流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户不断取消订阅，你想建立系统化的挽留机制。
copy.tagline_en: Reduce churn by building cancellation flows and retention strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users keep canceling and you want to build systematic retention.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计取消流程、设置挽留优惠、恢复失败支付，并制定客户留存策略。它会先收集你的订阅数据，然后按步骤构建或优化方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“流失”、“取消流程”、“挽留优惠”、“支付失败恢复”等关键词，或想减少用户取消订阅时触发。

say.text: 我的月流失率是5%，怎么设计一个取消流程？
帮我设置支付失败后的重试和邮件提醒。
say.note: Claude 会给出智能重试策略和催款邮件序列。

say.text: 如何根据取消原因匹配不同的挽留优惠？
say.note: Claude 会解释原因与优惠的对应关系，并给出示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design cancellation flows, set up save offers, recover failed payments, and implement retention strategies. It first gathers your subscription data, then builds or optimizes the solution step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'churn', 'cancel flow', 'save offer', 'failed payment recovery', or want to reduce subscriber cancellations.

say_en.text: My monthly churn rate is 5%. How do I design a cancel flow?
Set up retries and email reminders for failed payments.
say_en.note: Claude will provide smart retry logic and a dunning email sequence.

say_en.text: How to match save offers to cancellation reasons?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the mapping and give examples.
